overall.zh: Agent 安全研究的快速增长，正在形成怎样的安全证据？这些证据能否被比较、被独立复用，并随着新发现得到修正？
overall.en: What safety evidence is the fast growth of agent-safety research producing — and can it be compared, reused independently, and revised as new findings arrive?

overallNote.zh: 这是组织问题的方式，不是已经成立的结论；主线由后续结果决定。研究数量描述的是注意力分布，不等于现实风险。
overallNote.en: This is a way of organising the questions, not a result; the main line will follow the results. Research counts describe attention, not real-world risk.

q.zh: 研究关注如何变化，哪些方向容易被忽略，变化能否被可靠识别
q.en: How attention moves, which directions are overlooked, and whether change can be spotted reliably

q.zh: 研究用什么资源与实验支持安全主张，结论适用于哪些条件
q.en: What resources and experiments support safety claims, and under which conditions they hold

q.zh: 共享基础能否支持比较，成果能否被独立团队实际采用
q.en: Whether shared foundations support comparison, and whether work is taken up by independent teams

q.zh: 开放问题和外部反例如何得到回应，主张是否随新证据修订
q.en: How open problems and outside counter-evidence are answered, and whether claims are revised

title.zh: 一个方向的防御论文增多时，共同评测基础是否已经形成？
title.en: When defences pile up in a direction, is a shared evaluation base already there?

why.zh: 看研究活动与评测基础设施在时间上的关系，找出需要先建设或整合基准的方向。
why.en: Relates research activity to evaluation infrastructure in time, to show which directions need benchmarks first.

prior.zh: 此前以“某类论文累计达到 5 篇”为起点：19 个星团中 8 个的基准晚于攻击至少 6 个月，防御晚 6 个月以上的有 2 个（A3.7）。阈值起点是操作定义，不是方向的真实起源。
prior.en: With 'five works of a kind' as the start: in 8 of 19 clusters benchmarks got there at least six months after attacks, defences in 2 (A3.7). A count threshold is an operational start, not the true origin of a direction.

prop.zh: 在部分方向，防御产出先于共同评测基础形成；基准提出之后，可能还要等较长时间才被实际采用。
prop.en: In some directions defences come before a shared evaluation base, and a benchmark may wait long after release before it is used.

how.zh: 方向级时间线：攻击、基准、防御分别达到 3、5、10 篇的时间差；另算基准从发布到首次被他人采用、首次被无共同作者团队采用的等待时间，尚未被采用的按删失处理。
how.en: Direction-level timelines: when attacks, benchmarks and defences reach 3, 5 and 10 works; separately, the wait from a benchmark's release to first use by others and by a team sharing no author, treating not-yet-used benchmarks as censored.

alt.zh: 小方向达到固定阈值天然更慢；贡献类型标签、预印本去重和早期文献缺失都会移动起点；需要控制方向规模和年龄。
alt.en: Small directions reach a fixed count later; contribution labels, preprint deduplication and missing early literature move the start; size and age need control.

can.zh: 若多个阈值下都稳定滞后，可以说这些方向的共同评测基础形成较晚。
can.en: If the lag holds across thresholds, the shared evaluation base formed late in those directions.

cannot.zh: 时间先后不能说明缺少基准导致防御质量差；“达到 N 篇”不是方向的真实起点。
cannot.en: Order in time does not show that missing benchmarks made defences weaker; reaching N works is not when a direction began.

ours.zh: 按篇数计基准会漏掉“一个基准就够用”的情况，所以加算基准“首次被他人采用”的等待时间（下方结果），尚未被采用的按删失处理；只计采用检测认得名称的基准，其余基准“看不到是否被用”，不当作“没被用”。
ours.en: Counting benchmark papers misses that one benchmark is often enough, so we add the wait until a benchmark is first used by others (below), with not-yet-used ones censored; only benchmarks whose names the use detection knows count, since for the others use cannot be seen.

next.zh: 控制方向规模与年龄后重做阈值分析；对等待时间按星团分层。
next.en: Redo the thresholds controlling for size and age; stratify the waits by cluster.

title.zh: 很少互相引用的研究方向，是否通过共同基准建立了实际联系？
title.en: Do directions that rarely cite each other connect through shared benchmarks?

why.zh: 判断只看引用网络会漏掉哪些研究关系。
why.en: Shows which research relations a citation network alone misses.

prior.zh: 此前：171 个星团对中 14 个既共享基准、引用联系又弱，其中 8 个涉及形式化保证；AgentDojo 被 17 个星团的 167 项工作用于实验（A3.7）。基准使用受全文覆盖与抽取召回限制。
prior.en: Before: 14 of 171 cluster pairs share benchmarks while citing each other little, 8 involving formal guarantees; AgentDojo is used by 167 works in 17 clusters (A3.7). Benchmark use is limited by full-text coverage and extraction recall.

prop.zh: 共享评测资源能揭示引用网络没有反映的跨方向联系；共享名称是否意味着可比实验，需另行验证。
prop.en: Shared evaluation resources reveal cross-direction links the citation network misses; whether a shared name means comparable experiments is a separate question.

how.zh: 对照引用网络与基准使用网络，在方向规模和资源流行度条件下评估共享程度；逐个移除最流行基准，看连接是否还在；人工复核关键连接的原文。
how.en: Compare the citation network with the benchmark-use network, conditioning on direction size and resource popularity; remove the most popular benchmarks one at a time and see whether links survive; check key links in the text.

alt.zh: 多标签星团会制造跨方向边，大基准天然覆盖更多方向；未观测到引用或使用不等于不存在。
alt.en: Multi-label clusters create cross edges and big benchmarks reach more directions by default; an unseen citation or use is not an absent one.

can.zh: 若控制规模和流行度、去掉头部基准后连接仍在，可说明评测资源构成引用之外的知识联系。
can.en: If links survive size and popularity controls and the removal of top benchmarks, evaluation resources form a link beyond citations.

cannot.zh: 若主要由一个超级基准撑起，只能说明枢纽资源的作用，不能说全领域在融合。
cannot.en: If one super-benchmark carries it, this shows a hub resource, not a field converging.

ours.zh: 头部基准在近两年基准使用中占比很高（见 F15），所以“去掉头部基准”是这一问的核心检查。我们只按每项工作的主星团计，避免多标签制造连接；“弱引用”= 互相引用不到按规模预期的一半，并以三分之一作为换口径（下方结果）。
ours.en: The top benchmark carries a large share of recent uses (F15), so removing top benchmarks is the core check. Each work counts in its main cluster only, so multi-label works cannot create links; weak = under half the citations the sizes predict, with a third as another definition (below).

next.zh: 人工或智能体复核关键连接的原文语境。
next.en: Check the source context of key links.

title.zh: 论文产出最多的机构，是否也提供了最多被外部使用的评测资源？
title.en: Do the institutions that publish most also supply the evaluation resources others use most?

why.zh: 区分产出与供给，看不同机构对知识基础设施的不同贡献。
why.en: Separates output from supply, to see different contributions to research infrastructure.

prior.zh: 此前：至少 5 篇论文的 ROR 机构中，产出前 15 与外部供给前 15 只重合 5 个；两项指标正相关（约 0.5）——有联系，不能写成无关（A3.7）。
prior.en: Before: among ROR institutions with five or more works, 5 of the top 15 by output are in the top 15 by outside supply; the two correlate positively (about 0.5) — related, not unrelated (A3.7).

prop.zh: 产出规模不能完整代表资源供给；有些机构的基础设施作用在论文数排名中不突出。
prop.en: Output does not fully represent supply; some institutions' infrastructure role does not show in paper counts.

how.zh: 比较排名相关、头部重合与排名变化；多机构成果按分数计数；供给分别按全部外部论文、无共同作者论文、无共同机构论文计算，并去掉单个热门基准重算。
how.en: Compare rank correlation, top-set overlap and rank changes; count multi-institution work fractionally; compute supply over all outside works, works sharing no author and works sharing no institution, and again without the most popular benchmark.

alt.zh: 机构规模、研究年龄、领域选择与 ROR 匹配误差都会影响结果；供给目前只看可识别的基准，不涵盖方法贡献。
alt.en: Size, age, field mix and ROR matching affect results; supply covers identifiable benchmarks only, not methods.

can.zh: 若差异在各口径下稳定，可以说机构贡献有多种形式。
can.en: If the difference holds across definitions, institutions contribute in different forms.

cannot.zh: 不能据此评价机构整体研究质量；若排名变化主要来自一个老牌基准，应突出的是该资源。
cannot.en: It does not rate research quality; if one long-standing benchmark drives the ranks, the story is that resource.

ours.zh: 现有卡片把“供给”称为“影响力”，范围过宽，已改称“资源供给”。供给按四种口径重算：全部他人使用、只计无共同作者团队、只计无共同机构团队、去掉头部基准（下方结果）。
ours.en: The card called supply 'influence', which is too broad; it is now 'resource supply'. Supply is recomputed four ways: all outside uses, teams sharing no author, teams sharing no institution, and without the top benchmark (below).

next.zh: 按机构规模与研究年龄分层，看差异是否仍在。
next.en: Stratify by institution size and age to see whether the difference holds.

title.zh: 基准数量增加，是否必然削弱共同评测基础？
title.en: Does a growing number of benchmarks necessarily weaken the shared evaluation base?

why.zh: 不同基准可以覆盖不同问题，多样化也可能与更广泛的共同使用同时发生。
why.en: Different benchmarks cover different problems; diversity can grow with wider shared use.

prior.zh: 此前：半年度使用的基准数从 3 增至 76，最大基准份额从 57.1% 降至 31.6%；同一半年中有基准使用记录的防御论文对，共用基准的比例由约 10% 升到 26.3%（A3.7）。各期样本量不同，端点变化不能直接解释为标准化。
prior.en: Before: benchmarks used per half-year rose from 3 to 76 and the top share fell from 57.1% to 31.6%; among same-half-year defence pairs with recorded benchmark use, the share sharing one rose from about 10% to 26.3% (A3.7). Sample sizes differ, so the endpoints are not evidence of standardisation.

prop.zh: 评测生态的多样化与共同基础的形成可以同时发生。
prop.en: Diversification and a shared base can grow at the same time.

how.zh: 同时计算基准丰富度、有效数量、头部份额、论文对共享率与使用图连通性；固定或重采样各期论文数，在相同星团组成下比较；按论文或星团重采样估计不确定性。
how.en: Track richness, effective number, top share, pair sharing and connectivity together; fix or resample each period's papers under the same cluster mix; bootstrap by paper or cluster.

alt.zh: 近期全文覆盖、每篇基准数、星团组成和别名都会造成变化；论文对之间共享论文，不能当独立样本。
alt.en: Full-text coverage, benchmarks per paper, cluster mix and aliases move these; pairs share papers and are not independent.

can.zh: 若控制组成后多样性与共享率仍同时上升，资源扩张是有连接的扩张。
can.en: If both rise under a fixed mix, the growth of resources stays connected.

cannot.zh: 共用一个基准名称不等于实验可以比较，这要由 F16 判断。
cannot.en: Sharing a benchmark name is not comparability; that is F16.

ours.zh: 先前页面“共享率由约 10% 升到 26.3%”的终点是尚未结束的 2026 下半年，与完整半年不可比；只看完整半年，共享率基本持平。这里只用完整半年，并在每期固定样本量重抽，给出基准数、有效数量与防御论文对共享率的区间（下方结果）。网页卡片已同步改正。
ours.en: The earlier page's rise of pair sharing 'from about 10% to 26.3%' ended in the second half of 2026, which is still running and not comparable with complete half-years; over complete half-years sharing is flat. Only complete half-years are used here, resampled to a fixed size per period, with intervals for the number of benchmarks, their effective number and the share of defence pairs sharing one (below). The web card is corrected.

next.zh: 在相同星团组成下重复，并按论文重采样。
next.en: Repeat under the same cluster mix, resampling by paper.

title.zh: Agent 安全的研究对象与攻击入口在怎样变化？
title.en: How are the objects and entry points of agent-safety research changing?

why.zh: 描述研究活动的分布与变化，为比较验证方式提供背景；不估计现实风险的发生率。
why.en: Describes where research activity is and how it moves, as background for how it is tested; not an estimate of real-world risk.

prior.zh: 此前：近 12 个月相对前 12 个月，全领域约 ×2.7；企业工作流约 ×6.8、编程 ×6.7、MCP 与技能生态 ×5.3；攻击论文中工具描述、工具输出与 agent 间消息增长较快（A3.7）。
prior.en: Before: the last 12 months against the 12 before, the field about ×2.7; enterprise workflows ×6.8, coding ×6.7, MCP and skills ×5.3; among attacks, tool descriptions, tool outputs and agent-to-agent messages grew fastest (A3.7).

prop.zh: 研究关注正更多转向工具、执行和系统交互；这些方向的评测是否同步覆盖行动后果与组合风险，值得检验。
prop.en: Attention is moving toward tools, execution and system interaction; whether their evaluations also cover consequences and combined risks is worth testing.

how.zh: 同时报告绝对数、份额与增长倍数，用完整可比的时间窗；固定方向集合，区分新标签出现和原方向增长；在同一批论文上连接 F1、F14、F21、F22。
how.en: Report counts, shares and growth together over complete windows; fix the set of directions and separate new labels from growth; join F1, F14, F21 and F22 on the same papers.

alt.zh: 小基数会产生很大的倍数，类别定义更新也会制造趋势；份额下降可能仍伴随绝对增长。
alt.en: Small bases give large ratios and label changes create trends; a falling share can come with absolute growth.

can.zh: 趋势稳定时，可以作为“评测需求在变”的背景。
can.en: A stable trend is background for 'what evaluation must cover is changing'.

cannot.zh: 论文数量变化不代表现实攻击频率或风险；单独不宜承担主要结论。
cannot.en: Paper counts are not attack frequency or risk; on its own this is not a main result.

ours.zh: “研究的是哪些 agent”“攻击从哪些入口进来”“重心往哪里移”三张卡合并为一个入口，各自的统计集合与时间窗保留。
ours.en: The cards on agent kinds, entry points and focus shift share one entry here; each keeps its own population and window.

next.zh: 与 F21、F22 在同一批 2026 年论文上做联合分析。
next.en: Joint analysis with F21 and F22 on the same 2026 papers.

title.zh: 论文代码公开之后，是否被后续研究实际采用、扩展或复现？
title.en: After a paper releases code, is it actually used, extended or reproduced by later research?

why.zh: 公开链接、软件活跃度与研究转移是不同现象，需要分别测量。
why.en: A public link, software activity and research transfer are different things and need separate measures.

prior.zh: 此前：论文代码中位 5 颗星，46.7% 未检测到许可证；超过一年的论文代码中 15.1% 近半年有提交；工具仓库 81.1% 活跃，但两组年龄差别大，不能据此说论文代码更易被遗弃（A3.7）。
prior.en: Before: paper code has a median of 5 stars and 46.7% have no licence detected; 15.1% of paper code over a year old was pushed in the last six months; tool repositories 81.1%, but the sets differ in age, so this does not show paper code is abandoned more (A3.7).

prop.zh: 开源发布不会自动变成可确认的研究复用；某些低关注资源可能通过具体方法或实验链条产生实际影响。
prop.en: Release does not by itself become confirmed reuse; some low-attention code may matter through methods or experiments.

how.zh: 区分作者实现、外部复现、功能扩展和仅提及链接；按仓库年龄匹配维护指标；对可追溯的采用链人工复核。
how.en: Separate author implementations, outside reproductions, extensions and mere links; match upkeep by repository age; check traceable adoption chains by hand.

alt.zh: 成熟稳定的代码不需要频繁提交；星数不等于使用；许可证检测会漏识别，不能做法律判断。
alt.en: Stable code needs few commits; stars are not use; licence detection misses some and is not a legal judgement.

can.zh: 若采用集中于少数资源，可指出转移瓶颈；若低活跃仓库仍被稳定复用，应修正“提交少即无用”的判断。
can.en: If adoption concentrates on a few resources, that is a bottleneck; if quiet repositories are still reused, 'few commits means unused' is wrong.

cannot.zh: 结论限于可观测的公开研究复用，不推断生产部署。
cannot.en: Limited to observable public research reuse; nothing about production deployment.

ours.zh: 维护比较已按仓库年龄匹配（下方结果），排除了“两组年龄不同”这个解释；但更新不等于使用。引用意图里“使用对方的代码或工具”可以作为采用证据的一部分（见 F18、F23），仓库层面的复用关系还需要新的抽取。
ours.en: Upkeep is now compared at matched repository age (below), which removes the age explanation; upkeep is still not use. Citation intents that say 'uses the cited code or tool' give part of the adoption evidence (F18, F23); repository-level reuse needs new extraction.

next.zh: 从引用意图中取“使用其代码或工具”的证据，接到具体仓库。
next.en: Take 'uses its code or tool' evidence from citation intents and link it to repositories.

title.zh: 较早连接多个方向的工作，是否更可能出现在后来增长的方向中？
title.en: Are works that connect several directions early more likely to sit in directions that grow later?

why.zh: 关系到平台能否帮助发现尚未成为热点的研究机会。
why.en: Bears on whether the platform can help spot opportunities before they become hot.

prior.zh: 此前：年轻候选星团约 62% 的引用来自簇外，较老的约 40.4%（设最低引用数）。这是按年龄分组的回顾性差异；F12 提示简单信号在时间外可能很弱（A3.7）。
prior.en: Before: young candidate clusters draw about 62% of citations from outside, older ones 40.4% (minimum citation count). A retrospective difference by age; F12 suggests simple signals are weak out of time (A3.7).

prop.zh: 跨方向重组可能与后续增长有关，但预测价值必须在时间外数据中验证。
prop.en: Recombination may relate to later growth, but its predictive value has to be shown on later data.

how.zh: 预先定义目标（如 12 个月内进入头部）；把跨簇引用、语义混合与只用年龄、规模、近期增长的基线比较；滚动时间切分，保留未参与选择的测试窗口。
how.en: Fix the target in advance (e.g. entering the head within 12 months); compare cross-cluster citation and semantic mixing with baselines of age, size and recent growth; rolling splits with untouched test windows.

alt.zh: 用全部未来论文得到的聚类会泄漏信息；年轻方向本就更依赖外部基础。
alt.en: Clusters built with future papers leak information; young directions lean on outside work by nature.

can.zh: 若多个窗口稳定优于基线，可报告有限的预测价值。
can.en: If it beats baselines across windows, a limited predictive value.

cannot.zh: 若不优于基线，只能作回顾性描述，用来界定平台推荐功能的边界。
cannot.en: If not, it stays a retrospective description that marks what the platform can recommend.

ours.zh: 现有候选星团是用全部数据聚出来的；严格的时间外检验需要按当时的数据重新聚类，在此之前只报告回顾性差异。
ours.en: The candidate clusters were built on all data; a strict out-of-time test needs re-clustering on data available at the time. Until then only the retrospective difference is reported.

next.zh: 按时间点冻结的聚类与滚动回测。
next.en: Time-frozen clustering and rolling back tests.

title.zh: 被反复提出的开放问题，后来得到了什么形式的回应？
title.en: What kind of response do repeatedly raised open problems get?

why.zh: 区分出现相关论文、提出工具、开展评测，以及在特定条件下真正解决。
why.en: Separates related papers, tools, evaluations and an actual solution under stated conditions.

prior.zh: 此前：从 6,330 篇论文抽取约 15,037 段开放问题表述，归并出 31 个至少重复 3 次的问题，其中 4 个未发现后续关联工作（A3.7）。关联按引用与语义相似，不能证明问题被解决或无人研究。
prior.en: Before: about 15,037 open-problem statements from 6,330 papers merge into 31 problems raised three times or more; 4 have no later related Atlas work (A3.7). Relation is by citation and semantic similarity, which shows neither solution nor neglect.

prop.zh: 相关工作的增长与问题获得实质回应可能不同步；某些长期问题会在新的系统设置中反复出现。
prop.en: Growth of related work and a substantive response may not go together; some old problems return in new system settings.

how.zh: 对重复问题分层抽样、人工归并；把回应编码为讨论、方法、基准、评测、局部解决或证据不足；记录首次相关回应与首次直接检验的等待时间，保留未观测到回应的条目。
how.en: Sample recurring problems by stratum and merge by hand; code responses as discussion, method, benchmark, evaluation, partial solution or insufficient evidence; record waits to the first related response and first direct test, keeping problems with none seen.

alt.zh: 局限部分常含礼貌性的未来工作；自动归并可能把不同问题混为一谈；文献覆盖与发表滞后会造成假空白。
alt.en: Limitations sections hold polite future work; automatic merging can join different problems; coverage and lag create false gaps.

can.zh: 可以用少量证据链案例说明知识如何更新。
can.en: A few traced cases can show how knowledge is updated.

cannot.zh: “未观测到回应”不等于无人研究或没有解决；措辞用“未观测到充分回应”或“条件性解决”。
cannot.en: 'No response seen' is not 'unstudied' or 'unsolved'; say 'no sufficient response observed' or 'solved under conditions'.

ours.zh: 现有卡片标题“却没人接手”超出了测量能力，已改为中性问法。31 个问题的回应编码需要人工完成，我们先为每个问题列出候选回应论文和原文，放进审计页。
ours.en: The card title 'that no one takes up' overreached and is now neutral. Coding responses for the 31 problems needs people; we list candidate responding papers with their text in the audit page.

next.zh: 生成候选回应清单，在审计页人工编码。
next.en: Candidate response lists, coded by hand in the audit page.

title.zh: 自动裁判是否实际评判了同家族模型的结果？
title.en: Do automatic judges actually grade models of their own family?

why.zh: 这种配置有多常见、是否经过验证，决定了相关结论有多独立。
why.en: How common this is, and whether it is checked, bears on how independent the conclusions are.

prior.zh: 此前：同时识别到裁判和被测模型的 659 篇论文中，71% 存在家族重合（A3.7）。这是同一论文内的角色共现，不是核实过的评判关系；LLM 裁判的自我偏好已有研究，不是这里的新发现。
prior.en: Before: in 659 papers naming both a judge and a studied model, 71% share a family (A3.7). This is co-occurrence of roles in a paper, not a verified judging relation; self-preference of LLM judges is known from prior work and is not the claim here.

prop.zh: 同家族配置可能广泛存在；平台可以刻画具体的评判关系与验证方式，而不只是报告共现比例。
prop.en: Same-family set-ups may be common; the platform can describe the actual judging relations and how they are checked, not just a co-occurrence share.

how.zh: 先核实共现能否还原真实的评判边（裁判 → 被评模型）；与保持家族流行度和每篇被测家族的随机基线比较；统计人工校验、跨家族裁判和敏感性分析的覆盖。
how.en: Check whether co-occurrence recovers real judge-to-target edges; compare with a baseline that keeps family popularity and each paper's studied families; count human validation, cross-family judges and sensitivity analyses.

alt.zh: 热门家族与多目标评测天然更容易重合；同家族不等于同一模型；两个自动标注器的一致率不等于人工准确率。
alt.en: Popular families and many targets overlap by default; same family is not same model; agreement of two automatic labellers is not human accuracy.

can.zh: 若超出条件基线且缺乏独立校验，可报告验证依赖结构值得关注。
can.en: If above the conditional baseline and rarely checked, the dependence structure deserves attention.

cannot.zh: 没有重新评测或对照实验，不能说重合导致了偏差。
cannot.en: Without re-judging or controls, overlap cannot be said to cause bias.

ours.zh: 分三层：第一层（共现）已加上条件基线，见下方结果；第二层由实验方案卡读出“裁判判谁”；第三层（换裁判后结论是否变化）原计划用重判实验，已按你的决定暂停，因此本问最多回答到“配置与核实”，不回答“是否造成偏差”。
ours.en: Three levels: level 1 (co-occurrence) now has a conditional baseline, below; level 2 reads 'who judges whom' from the protocol cards; level 3 (do conclusions move with the judge) was the re-judging experiment, paused by the owner, so this question stops at set-ups and their checks and does not answer whether they cause bias.

next.zh: 智能体审计中 20 条评判边有 4 条错误：占位符号当成了模型名，或把基线检测器、标注编码器当成了评判模型输出的裁判。下一步把这两类排除后重算第二层。
next.en: In the agent audit 4 of 20 judge edges were wrong: placeholder symbols taken as model names, or baseline detectors and annotation coders taken as judges of model outputs. Next, recompute level 2 without these two kinds.

title.zh: 开放权重模型与 API 模型是否承担不同的研究角色？
title.en: Do open-weight and API models play different roles in research?

why.zh: 被测对象开放、而裁判或数据生成依赖封闭服务时，整个实验流程的可复现条件会变。
why.en: When the tested model is open but the judge or data generator is a closed service, the reproducibility of the whole pipeline changes.

prior.zh: 此前：GPT 家族约 23% 的论文记录涉及当裁判，Claude 约 18%；Qwen 约 25% 涉及训练，Llama 约 17%（A3.7）。分母是各家族自己的论文集合，角色可重叠，不能相加或当作全体论文占比。
prior.en: Before: about 23% of GPT papers use it as a judge, Claude 18%; Qwen is trained in about 25%, Llama 17% (A3.7). Each base is that family's papers and roles overlap, so these neither add up nor are shares of all papers.

prop.zh: 模型生态存在角色分工；完整流程的可复现性取决于多个角色，而不只是被测模型是否开放。
prop.en: Roles divide across the model ecosystem; reproducibility depends on several roles, not only whether the tested model is open.

how.zh: 构建论文内的角色组合矩阵，统计“开放被测 + 封闭裁判”“开放攻击者 + 封闭被测”等配置；记录是否公开提示词、输出、模型版本和评测脚本。
how.en: Build the within-paper matrix of role combinations — open target with closed judge, open attacker with closed target, and so on; record whether prompts, outputs, versions and scripts are released.

alt.zh: 家族级标签掩盖版本差异；API 可用不等于版本可固定。
alt.en: Family labels hide versions; an available API is not a pinned version.

can.zh: 若流程跨越开放与封闭生态，可报告实验流程的复现条件，并识别固定版本、公开输出等良好做法。
can.en: If pipelines cross open and closed models, that sets their reproducibility conditions; pinned versions and released outputs are good practice to show.

cannot.zh: 不以开放性标签给论文整体质量打分。
cannot.en: No quality score from an openness label.

ours.zh: 论文内的角色组合矩阵由已有的模型角色标注算出（下方结果）；开放与否按模型登记表，一个家族内版本的开放状态不同时按版本计。“是否公开提示词、版本”要等实验方案卡的相应字段。
ours.en: The within-paper role matrix comes from the existing role labels (below); openness follows the model registry, by version where a family mixes. Release of prompts and versions waits for the protocol fields.

next.zh: 加入“是否公开提示词与版本”，看开放被测 + 封闭裁判的论文是否用公开输出等方式降低了依赖。
next.en: Add release of prompts and versions, to see whether papers with open targets and closed judges reduce the dependence, e.g. by releasing outputs.

title.zh: 单个冷门方向翻身的概率低，但新进入头部的方向里有多少来自冷门群体？
title.en: Each cold direction rarely rises, but how many new head entries come from the cold group?

why.zh: 区分个体成功概率与群体总贡献。
why.en: Separates the chance of one direction from the contribution of the group.

prior.zh: 此前按“方向 × 季度”回测：冷门 679 个观测中 62 次一年后进入头部（9.1%），其余长尾 118/547（21.6%）；全部 180 次进入中 62 次来自冷门（A3.7）。重复季度可能属于同一方向，62 次不是 62 个方向。
prior.en: Before, by direction-quarter: 62 of 679 cold observations reached the head a year later (9.1%), the rest of the tail 118 of 547 (21.6%); 62 of the 180 entries came from the cold (A3.7). Repeated quarters can be one direction, so 62 events are not 62 directions.

prop.zh: 冷门单体转热概率较低，但因群体规模大，仍可能对新热点有可观贡献。
prop.en: Each cold line rarely rises, yet the cold group may still supply a sizeable share of new head lines.

how.zh: 同时报告条件成功率、基数和贡献份额；按方向去重，只算首次进入；改变冷门分位与头部阈值；按方向重采样估计不确定性。
how.en: Report the conditional rate, the base and the contribution together; deduplicate to first entries per direction; vary the cold quantile and the head threshold; bootstrap by direction.

alt.zh: 方向分类用了未来数据会泄漏；小方向增长倍数天然偏大；进入头部不等于科学价值更高。
alt.en: Clusters from future data leak; small lines have large ratios by nature; entering the head is not higher value.

can.zh: 若去重后群体贡献仍稳定，可支持保留长尾可见性的价值。
can.en: If the group share holds after deduplication, keeping the long tail visible is worthwhile.

cannot.zh: 不意味着应当押注任何一个冷门方向，也不证明可预测。
cannot.en: Not a reason to bet on any single cold line, and not a prediction.

ours.zh: 按研究线去重的“首次进入头部”已补算（下方结果），与“方向 × 季度”口径并列给出；一条线按它第一次进入头部时所在的组计。
ours.en: First entries per line are now computed (below), beside the direction-quarter count; a line counts for the group it was in when it first entered the head.

next.zh: 改变冷门分位与头部阈值；按研究线重采样给出区间。
next.en: Vary the cold quantile and the head threshold; bootstrap by line for intervals.

title.zh: 平台展示的潜力信号，能否在未来数据中稳定识别增长方向？
title.en: Do the platform's early signals pick out growing directions on later data?

why.zh: 区分回顾性解释与真正可用的预测能力。
why.en: Separates retrospective explanation from usable prediction.

prior.zh: 此前：冷门组合信号在同一分析集合中提升约 1.79 倍；用 2024 年选出的信号在 2025 年检验，提升约 1.18 倍（A3.7）。两者基线不同，不能用同一个 9.1% 换算，也缺完整测试样本和区间。
prior.en: Before: the combined cold-line signal lifts the rate about ×1.79 on the same set; picked on 2024 and tested on 2025, about ×1.18 (A3.7). The baselines differ, so neither converts with the same 9.1%, and the test sample and intervals are incomplete.

prop.zh: 看似有解释力的信号，时间外增益可能明显减弱；也可能有少数信号在严格控制后仍有有限价值。
prop.en: Signals that look explanatory may weaken a lot out of time; a few may keep limited value under strict control.

how.zh: 滚动时间验证；以规模、年龄、近期增长和随机选择为基线；报告命中率、覆盖率、提升、校准与不确定性，按方向聚类处理重复季度；完整记录失败的信号。
how.en: Rolling validation; baselines of size, age, recent growth and random choice; report hit rate, coverage, lift, calibration and uncertainty, clustering repeated quarters by direction; log failed signals.

alt.zh: 未来生成的簇标签、全样本选阈值、多次尝试只报最好，都会高估性能。
alt.en: Labels from the future, thresholds chosen on all data and reporting only the best try all overstate performance.

can.zh: 若增益稳定，明确其适用范围与误差。
can.en: If gains are stable, state where they hold and their error.

cannot.zh: 若接近基线，平台应定位为辅助探索而非预测热点；弱信号也不证明未来原则上不可预测。
cannot.en: If near baseline, the platform aids exploration, not forecasting; weak signals do not show the future is unpredictable in principle.

ours.zh: 现有 1.18 倍来自一次切分，需要多个窗口和区间之后才能当结论用。
ours.en: The ×1.18 comes from one split; it needs several windows and intervals before it can be a result.

next.zh: 多窗口滚动回测与区间。
next.en: Multi-window rolling back test with intervals.

title.zh: 机器人和物理 agent 接入语言模型、工具、检索与记忆后，相关安全研究是否覆盖了这些连接？
title.en: As robots and physical agents take up language models, tools, retrieval and memory, does safety research cover these connections?

why.zh: 定位有实际系统基础的交叉方向。
why.en: Locates crossings that real systems actually have.

prior.zh: 此前：物理 agent 与工具接口交叉 45 篇、与检索交叉 20 篇；行列独立基线的期望约 502 和 170（A3.7）。该期望只是边际乘积，不代表应有的研究量。
prior.en: Before: 45 works cross physical agents with tool interfaces and 20 with retrieval; the independence baseline expects about 502 and 170 (A3.7). That is a product of margins, not how much research there should be.

prop.zh: 在确实使用这些组件的物理系统中，数字攻击入口与物理后果之间的连接可能较少被直接验证。
prop.en: Among physical systems that do use these components, links from digital entry points to physical consequences may rarely be tested directly.

how.zh: 先确定适用的系统集合（确实有工具、检索、记忆或协作的物理系统），再统计组件与安全要求的交叉覆盖；对稀疏交叉抽取原文核验。
how.en: First fix the applicable systems (physical systems that do have tools, retrieval, memory or collaboration), then count coverage against safety requirements; check sparse crossings in the text.

alt.zh: 传统控制或不使用这些组件的机器人不应进入分母；类别不独立；数量不衡量风险。
alt.en: Classical-control robots without these components do not belong in the base; categories are not independent; counts are not risk.

can.zh: 若在适用系统中仍缺直接评测，可提出具体的交叉研究问题。
can.en: If applicable systems still lack direct tests, specific crossing questions follow.

cannot.zh: 若合理分母消除了差异，应撤回宽泛的空白判断。
cannot.en: If a sensible base removes the gap, the broad 'gap' claim goes.

ours.zh: 适用分母用“物理 agent 论文中点名语言或视觉语言模型的论文”近似（限有全文的 2026 年论文）；这是近似，不是对系统功能的核验，会在结果旁写明。
ours.en: We approximate the applicable base by physical-agent papers that name a language or vision-language model (2026 papers with full text); an approximation, not a check of system functions, and labelled as such.

next.zh: 抽样核验适用集合（是否真的接入了工具、检索或记忆）。
next.en: Check a sample of the applicable set (do they really connect tools, retrieval or memory).

title.zh: 论文用了新模型，是否意味着它测试的对象也是新模型？
title.en: Does using a new model mean the model under test is new?

why.zh: 被测、裁判、攻击者与数据生成模型的更新速度可能不同，需要分别观察。
why.en: Studied, judge, attacker and data-generation models may update at different speeds and need separate views.

prior.zh: 此前按论文点名的最新语言模型估计：中位约 6 个月，约 29.2% 没有点名一年内的新模型（A3.7）。未按角色区分，不能当作被测模型的年龄。
prior.en: Before, by the newest language model a paper names: a median of about 6 months, about 29.2% name none from the past year (A3.7). Not split by role, so not the tested model's age.

prop.zh: 论文整体的“新”可能主要来自裁判或数据生成模型；被测对象和攻击者的更新速度可能不同。相反结果同样保留。
prop.en: A paper's freshness may come mostly from its judge or data generator; tested models and attackers may lag differently. The opposite result is kept too.

how.zh: 以论文首次公开时间减去该角色模型的可用时间，按角色报告分布；同一论文中比较被测模型与裁判、攻击者的年龄差。
how.en: Age = paper date minus the model's availability date, by role; within a paper, compare the studied model's age with the judge's and the attacker's.

alt.zh: 部分日期用的是 OpenRouter 首次上架月份，不总等于厂商发布日期；滚动 API 别名、论文修订会造成误差；年龄不等于能力。
alt.en: Some dates are OpenRouter listing months, not always vendor release dates; rolling aliases and revisions add error; age is not capability.

can.zh: 若角色差异显著，应修正“用最新模型代表评测前沿”的做法。
can.en: If roles differ a lot, 'newest model named' should not stand for 'evaluation at the frontier'.

cannot.zh: 没有结果前不能写成被测模型普遍落后。
cannot.en: Until computed, do not say tested models lag.

ours.zh: 按角色的年龄与论文内“被测 vs 裁判”的配对差已算出（下方结果）；另附“新模型论文是否更多研究新场景”。年龄按论文所在月份与模型可用月份之差计，一个角色有多个模型时取最新的一个，换成最旧的一个作为换口径。
ours.en: Ages by role and the within-paper studied-versus-judge difference are computed (below), with whether new-model papers study new settings more. Age is the paper month minus the model's availability month; with several models in a role the newest counts, the oldest as another definition.

next.zh: 核对模型可用日期的来源（厂商发布 vs 上架月份）对结果的影响。
next.en: Check how the date source (vendor release or listing month) affects the result.

title.zh: 评测是否集中依赖少数基准、裁判和被测模型？
title.en: Does evaluation lean on a few benchmarks, judges and tested models?

why.zh: 区分研究方向的多样性与证据来源的多样性。
why.en: Separates diversity of directions from diversity of evidence sources.

prior.zh: 此前页面分别给出主题、基准使用与模型角色，没有跨角色的共同依赖分析。
prior.en: Earlier pages gave topics, benchmark use and model roles separately, with no joint dependence analysis.

prop.zh: 主题扩张可能伴随评测依赖集中，也可能伴随更多独立来源；共同依赖支持标准化，也让替代验证更重要。
prop.en: Growth of topics may come with concentrated dependence or with more sources; shared dependence helps standardisation and makes alternative checks matter more.

how.zh: 按基准、裁判、被测模型分别计算头部份额、集中度和跨方向覆盖；模拟移除一个主要资源后多少评测配置需要替换。
how.en: Top shares, concentration and reach, separately for benchmarks, judges and tested models; simulate how many set-ups would need replacing without one main resource.

alt.zh: 移除模拟只说明配置依赖，不说明结论失效；家族合并与角色识别误差会改变集中度。
alt.en: Removal shows dependence of set-ups, not that conclusions fail; family merging and role errors change concentration.

can.zh: 若集中且缺乏替代验证，可报告共同依赖结构；若集中伴随跨来源复核，可视为成熟规范。
can.en: Concentration without alternative checks is a dependence structure; with cross-checks it is a maturing norm.

cannot.zh: 不能把不同角色的份额合成一个总分。
cannot.en: Shares of different roles do not add up to one score.

ours.zh: 基准使用只看 Atlas 收录的基准，Atlas 之外的看不到；所以头部份额是“使用 Atlas 基准的论文中”的份额，分母处已写明。
ours.en: Benchmark use covers Atlas benchmarks only; shares are among works that use one, as the denominator says.

next.zh: 加入环境与攻击者两类资源。
next.en: Add environments and attackers as resources.

title.zh: 两篇论文使用同一个基准时，能否直接比较它们的结果？
title.en: When two papers use the same benchmark, can their results be compared directly?

why.zh: 把共享资源落实到实验条件。
why.en: Takes shared resources down to experimental conditions.

prior.zh: F2、F4 给出共同基准使用的观察，但协议层面的可比性还没有量化；不能预先假定可比性很低。
prior.en: F2 and F4 give shared-benchmark observations; protocol-level comparability has not been measured and should not be assumed low.

prop.zh: 共享基准名称与实验可比性可能不同步；也可能有少数基准已经形成稳定协议。
prop.en: Shared names and comparability may diverge; a few benchmarks may already have a stable protocol.

how.zh: 按比较目的定义核心条件；把同一基准上的论文对分为：核心条件一致、需调整后比较、存在关键差异、报告不足。字段：版本与子集、目标模型、攻击权限与预算、防御配置、成功判据、裁判。
how.en: Define core conditions per purpose; classify paper pairs on a benchmark as same core conditions, comparable after adjustment, key differences, or under-reported. Fields: version and subset, target models, attacker access and budget, defences, success criterion, judge.

alt.zh: 不能把所有配置变化都当成不可比；共享论文的论文对不独立；“报告不足”与“已知不同”要分开。
alt.en: Not every change makes results incomparable; pairs sharing a paper are not independent; under-reported and known-different stay apart.

can.zh: 若共享增长而可比率不升，可描述规范形成的限制；若协议趋同，可报告共同基准的实际价值。
can.en: If sharing grows without comparability, that limits the norm; if protocols converge, shared benchmarks pay off.

cannot.zh: 条件一致也不保证实现正确或统计检验充分。
cannot.en: Same conditions do not guarantee correct implementations or adequate statistics.

ours.zh: “都报告了”不等于“相同”。所以第二轮把高使用基准上各论文报告的版本/子集和成功判据，分别归并成标准类别（Claude Opus 5.5），再按文档的四类给论文对分类；第一轮“是否报告”的统计保留为报告完整性。基准处没写目标模型时，用论文整体的被测模型补上，并写明比例。智能体审计发现，字段错误多是“标为未说明、但论文附录里其实写了”（抽取段落未覆盖附录），所以“报告不足”一类偏高，应读作上限；把“未写版本”视为默认完整版本的换口径也一并给出。
ours.en: Reported is not the same, so a second pass groups the versions or subsets and the success criteria each paper reports on the most-used benchmarks into canonical categories (Claude Opus 5.5) and classifies pairs into the document's four classes; the first pass stays as reporting completeness. Where a benchmark use lists no targets, the paper's studied models stand in, with the share stated. The agent audit found most field errors were 'not stated' where an appendix does state it (the passages did not reach appendices), so 'under-reported' is too high and reads as an upper bound; treating an unstated version as the default release is given as another definition.

next.zh: 核对类别归并（同一版本的不同写法）对结果的影响；按比较目的（攻击效果 / 防御效果）分别定义核心条件。
next.en: Check how the grouping of versions affects the result; define core conditions separately for comparing attacks and defences.

title.zh: 一个基准的采用，有多少发生在提出者之外的团队？
title.en: How much of a benchmark's uptake happens outside its authors' teams?

why.zh: 外部论文数和独立团队数会给出不同的影响图景。
why.en: Counts of outside papers and of independent teams give different pictures of reach.

prior.zh: 此前有其他论文使用基准的关系，但没有连接共同作者、机构与时间。
prior.en: Earlier there were uses by other works, not linked to co-authors, institutions and time.

prop.zh: 按独立采用衡量后，部分资源的排名可能变化；总量一般的资源也可能被多个互不重合的团队使用。
prop.en: Ranked by independent adoption, some resources may move; moderately used ones may serve many separate teams.

how.zh: 分别计算首次被他人、首次被无共同作者团队、首次被无共同机构团队采用的等待时间；报告独立采用论文数、团队数与方向数；未被采用的按删失处理。
how.en: Waits to first use by others, by a team sharing no author, by a team sharing no institution; count independent papers, teams and directions; treat not-yet-used as censored.

alt.zh: 无作者或机构重合只是独立性的代理；作者消歧与机构缺失会造成偏差；未观测到外部采用不等于没有价值。
alt.en: No shared author or institution is a proxy for independence; disambiguation and missing institutions bias it; no outside use seen is not no value.

can.zh: 若排名变化稳定，可以识别跨团队的基础设施。
can.en: Stable rank changes identify cross-team infrastructure.

cannot.zh: 广泛独立采用不等于结论被成功复现。
cannot.en: Wide independent use is not successful reproduction.

ours.zh: 按作者与按机构两种口径差别明显，但按独立团队重排后的排名几乎不变（见下方结果）——这是“差异不大”的结果，按规则保留。
ours.en: By-author and by-institution definitions differ clearly, yet the ranking by independent teams barely changes (below) — a 'little difference' result, kept by rule.

next.zh: 补删失分析（尚未被采用的基准）。
next.en: Add censoring for benchmarks not yet used.

title.zh: 被广泛引用的成果，是否也被实际使用？
title.en: Are widely cited works also actually used?

why.zh: 区分概念贡献、背景知识、实验基线和可复用基础设施。
why.en: Separates conceptual contributions, background, baselines and reusable infrastructure.

prior.zh: F3 在机构层面比较产出与供给；本问下沉到具体成果。
prior.en: F3 compares output and supply for institutions; this takes it to single works.

prop.zh: 引用关注与实际用途可能存在稳定差异；某些资源对实验实践的重要性未被引用排名反映。
prop.en: Citation attention and use may differ stably; some resources matter for practice more than citations show.

how.zh: 同年、同星团、同类型内比较引用与使用排名；识别高引用低使用、低引用高使用等象限；把引用语境分为背景、采用、基线、复现、质疑。
how.en: Compare citation and use ranks within year, cluster and type; find high-cited/low-used and the reverse; classify citing contexts as background, adoption, baseline, reproduction, challenge.

alt.zh: 被引但未采用仍可能有重要的概念贡献；使用抽取的漏检会制造低使用象限。
alt.en: Cited but unused can still be an important idea; missed use detections create the low-use quadrant.

can.zh: 若差异稳定，可报告贡献形式的多样性。
can.en: A stable difference shows different forms of contribution.

cannot.zh: 不以用途指标替代科学价值判断。
cannot.en: Use does not replace a judgement of scientific value.

ours.zh: 先只做基准。引用语境由引用句的意图分类得到；“使用、采用、比较”的标签由 Claude Opus 5.5 按收严的规则复核，规则是：对方的资源必须真的在本文实验中运行，只是描述或自己重新实现都不算。另用全文中找到的基准使用关系交叉检查：引用句往往看不出实际使用，所以从引用句读出的“使用”是下限。
ours.en: Benchmarks first. Citing contexts come from classifying the citing sentences; 'uses, adopts, compares' labels were re-checked by Claude Opus 5.5 under stricter rules (the cited artefact must actually run in the citing paper's experiments; describing it or re-implementing it does not count). Uses found in full texts give a cross-check: citing sentences often do not show use, so use read from them is a lower bound.

next.zh: 引用意图结果进来后补“基准为何被引”。
next.en: Add why benchmarks are cited once citation intents are in.

title.zh: 报告安全提升的研究，是否同时说明了任务能力保留和成本？
title.en: Do papers reporting safety gains also show retained task ability and cost?

why.zh: 直接影响防御方法的适用范围。
why.en: Directly bounds where a defence can be used.

prior.zh: 此前没有平台统计。
prior.en: No earlier platform statistic.

prop.zh: 不同防御路线可能有不同的安全—效用权衡；有些可能同时改善两者。
prop.en: Defence approaches may trade off safety and utility differently; some may improve both.

how.zh: 第一阶段统计是否同配置配对报告安全、效用与成本，区分“未报告”与“不适用”；第二阶段只在可比实验内估计变化。
how.en: Stage one: whether safety, utility and cost are reported for the same configurations, separating not reported from not applicable; stage two: changes only within comparable experiments.

alt.zh: 跨论文的 ASR 分母、攻击强度、任务难度和成本口径不同，不能直接求平均；只报安全指标的论文不能判定效用下降。
alt.en: ASR bases, attack strength, task difficulty and cost differ across papers and cannot be averaged; a safety-only paper does not show a utility loss.

can.zh: 若配对报告稀少，可报告证据完整性的限制；稳定的双重改善也作为正面实践报告。
can.en: If paired reporting is rare, that limits the evidence; stable gains on both sides are reported as good practice.

cannot.zh: “未报告”不等于方法损害了效用。
cannot.en: Not reported is not harmed.

ours.zh: 实验方案卡读出“是否报告效用”“是否同配置配对”和所用效用指标；延迟、token 等成本记在效用指标里。这一阶段只回答报告完整性，不回答效果。
ours.en: The protocol card reads whether utility is reported, whether it is paired, and which metrics; latency and tokens are recorded among them. This stage answers completeness of reporting, not effects.

next.zh: 全量结果进来后出完整性矩阵。
next.en: Completeness matrix once the run is in.

title.zh: 攻防结论在多大范围的模型能力、预算和访问权限下成立？
title.en: Under what range of capability, budget and access do attack and defence results hold?

why.zh: 胜负需要带着具体条件来读。
why.en: Results need their conditions attached.

prior.zh: 此前没有联合统计。此前页面把摘要识别的 5.2% 与全文提及的 10.5% 当作自适应检验比例的上下界，这不成立：两者的总体与识别方式不同。
prior.en: No earlier joint statistic. The earlier page treated 5.2% (abstracts) and 10.5% (full-text mentions) as bounds on adaptive testing; they are not, as population and criterion differ.

prop.zh: 部分安全结论只在较窄配置下成立；另一些方法在多种能力与预算下保持稳定。
prop.en: Some results hold only in narrow set-ups; others stay stable across capabilities and budgets.

how.zh: 建立威胁模型与配置表（访问权限、预算、是否用自适应攻击检验）；优先用同一论文内的配置变化看敏感性。
how.en: Tabulate threat models and set-ups (access, budget, adaptive attacker); use within-paper variation first.

alt.zh: 资源不对称可能符合真实威胁模型；报告缺失不等于预算无限；保留“未知”，不自动补默认值。
alt.en: Asymmetry can match the real threat; missing is not unlimited; unknown stays unknown.

can.zh: 若结论对配置敏感，可描述适用边界与必须报告的条件。
can.en: If results are sensitive, describe their bounds and what must be reported.

cannot.zh: 没有实验对照时，只能报告配置分布，不能推断配置决定胜负。
cannot.en: Without controls, only the distribution of set-ups, not that set-ups decide outcomes.

ours.zh: 自适应攻击检验改为在同一批 2026 年防御论文中，从实验段落直接读取（做了 / 没做 / 未说明），取代旧的“上下界”说法；网页卡片已同步改正。
ours.en: Adaptive testing is now read from the experiment passages of one set of 2026 defences (yes / no / not stated), replacing the old bounds; the web card is corrected.

next.zh: 全量结果进来后报告。
next.en: Report once the run is in.

title.zh: 论文声称保护的层次，与它实际测量的层次一致吗？
title.en: Is what a paper claims to protect measured at the same layer?

why.zh: 区分输出内容、工具调用、环境状态变化和实际后果。
why.en: Separates output text, tool calls, environment state and real consequences.

prior.zh: F5 观察到工具与执行研究增长；尚无主张—测量对应的结果。
prior.en: F5 shows growth in tools and execution; no claim-to-measurement result yet.

prop.zh: 研究主题与结果测量可能以不同速度更新；也可能出现直接测量执行后果的新规范。
prop.en: Topics and measurement may update at different speeds; a norm of measuring consequences may be emerging.

how.zh: 分别编码声称保护的层次与实际测量的层次，建立对应矩阵；对代理指标记录验证依据。
how.en: Code the claimed and the measured layer and cross them; record how proxies are justified.

alt.zh: 文本指标可能就是某些任务的直接结果，工具调用也未必造成真实后果；四层不是质量等级。
alt.en: Text can be the direct outcome for some tasks and a tool call need not have consequences; the four layers are not a quality ladder.

can.zh: 若存在稳定错位，可报告限定主张范围的需要；若直接后果评测在增长，可识别方法进展。
can.en: A stable mismatch calls for narrower claims; growth of consequence-level tests is progress.

cannot.zh: 缺少真实部署不自动意味着实验无效。
cannot.en: No real deployment does not make an experiment invalid.

ours.zh: 实验方案卡只读了“实际测量层次”，所以补读了“声称保护的层次”（摘要与引言，规则 claims-v1，附原文短语），再与测量层次做对应矩阵（下方结果）。四层按“输出 < 工具调用 < 环境状态 < 实际后果”排序只是为了读矩阵，不是质量等级；主张超出测量本身不等于错，关键看代理指标有没有依据。
ours.en: The protocol cards read only the measured layer, so the claimed layer was read from abstracts and introductions (rules claims-v1, with quoted phrases) and crossed with it (below). The order output < tool call < environment state < consequence is for reading the matrix, not a quality ladder; a claim beyond the measurement is not wrong in itself, what matters is whether the proxy is justified.

next.zh: 抽查对角线以上的论文，看代理指标是否有依据。
next.en: Check the papers above the diagonal for how their proxies are justified.

title.zh: 系统同时使用工具、记忆、检索和多 agent 协作时，研究是否直接验证了风险在连接处的传播？
title.en: When systems combine tools, memory, retrieval and multiple agents, is risk propagation across those links tested directly?

why.zh: 单项覆盖充分并不自动提供组合证据。
why.en: Covering each part does not give evidence about combinations.

prior.zh: 主题同时出现不能证明实验测试了风险组合；此前没有组合验证覆盖率。
prior.en: Topics appearing together do not show combinations were tested; no earlier coverage figure.

prop.zh: 组件内与跨组件安全的证据可能分布不同；也可能存在跨多个环节起作用的防御。
prop.en: Evidence within and across components may differ; some defences may work across several links.

how.zh: 先建立具有真实组件连接的适用系统集合，再编码单环节测试、跨环节传播测试和组合防御测试。
how.en: Fix applicable systems with real component links, then code single-link tests, propagation tests and combined defences.

alt.zh: 稀疏组合可能源于系统根本没用相关组件；不能根据组合论文少推断系统易受攻击。
alt.en: Sparse combinations may mean systems lack those components; few papers does not mean vulnerable systems.

can.zh: 若适用系统中缺少连接处验证，可提出具体评测任务。
can.en: If applicable systems lack link-level tests, specific evaluation tasks follow.

cannot.zh: 不能由组合论文少推断风险大小。
cannot.en: Few papers on a combination says nothing about its risk.

ours.zh: 实验方案卡只记录论文实际测试的“入口 → 后果”链条（附原文），不记录只讨论过的组合。智能体审计发现一个设计缺陷：组件列表里没有“模型输出”这个落点，伤害体现在模型回答里的链条被归到了别的格子（4 个错误中 3 个）。因此链条的“影响”一端分布不可细读；“是否检验了至少一条跨组件链条”受影响较小。下一轮抽取会补上这个落点。
ours.en: Protocol cards record only entry-to-effect chains the experiments test, with the text, not combinations merely discussed. The agent audit found a design flaw: the component list has no 'model output' slot, so chains whose harm shows in the model's answer were put in other slots (3 of 4 errors). The distribution of effects should not be read closely; whether a paper tests at least one cross-component chain is less affected. The next extraction adds the slot.

next.zh: 全量结果进来后，按适用系统集合报告覆盖。
next.en: Report coverage on the applicable set once the run is in.

title.zh: 一个概念传到更多方向时，传播的是术语、方法，还是可运行的实现？
title.en: When an idea reaches more directions, is it the term, the method, or a working implementation that travels?

why.zh: 解释跨方向联系的实质。
why.en: Explains what cross-direction links are made of.

prior.zh: 此前以标题术语为线索，报告近期术语进入多个星团较快；标题出现不能证明方法迁移（A3.7）。
prior.en: Before: by title terms, recent terms reached many clusters faster; a term in a title does not show a method moved (A3.7).

prop.zh: 术语传播速度与方法实际采用速度可能不同。
prop.en: Terms and methods may spread at different speeds.

how.zh: 区分提及术语、引用概念、采用机制、复用代码与独立评测；跟踪各层次首次出现的时间与方向覆盖，在统一观察窗口内比较，保留删失。
how.en: Separate mentioning a term, citing a concept, adopting a mechanism, reusing code and independent evaluation; track first appearance and reach per level in a common window, with censoring.

alt.zh: 同名可能异义，异名可能同机制；新概念观察期更短，只统计达到阈值者会有幸存者偏差。
alt.en: Same names can mean different things and different names the same mechanism; newer ideas have shorter windows, and counting only those reaching a threshold favours survivors.

can.zh: 若词汇扩散快而实质采用慢，可区分讨论热度与研究转移。
can.en: If words spread faster than methods, discussion and transfer can be told apart.

cannot.zh: 没有识别设计时，不声称开源导致扩散加快。
cannot.en: Without a design, no claim that open source speeds it up.

ours.zh: 跨星团引用的意图（使用 / 采用方法 / 比较 / 背景）给出“方法层”一侧，按收严规则由 Claude Opus 5.5 复核（智能体审计中 20 条有 5 条把“只是描述”标成了“使用”）；术语层沿用标题术语。两者暂时只能并列，按概念一一对应还需要逐个核对。
ours.en: Intents of cross-cluster citations (uses, adopts a method, compares, background) give the method side, re-checked by Claude Opus 5.5 under stricter rules (in the agent audit 5 of 20 labelled a mere description as use); the term side stays title terms. For now they sit side by side; matching them concept by concept needs case checks.

next.zh: 引用意图全量后，报告跨星团引用中真正采用方法的比例。
next.en: Share of cross-cluster citations that adopt a method, once intents are in.

title.zh: 一种防御出现外部反例后，后续研究是否收紧主张、改变条件、采用修订版或提出替代？
title.en: After outside counter-evidence against a defence, does later work narrow claims, change conditions, adopt revisions or offer alternatives?

why.zh: 体现领域如何吸收新证据。
why.en: Shows how the field absorbs new evidence.

prior.zh: 此前没有统计；不能仅凭后续论文没有引用质疑研究，就判断它忽略了问题。
prior.en: No earlier statistic; not citing a challenge does not show it was ignored.

prop.zh: 不同研究路线吸收外部反证的速度和方式可能不同。
prop.en: Lines of work may absorb counter-evidence at different speeds and in different ways.

how.zh: 建立“提出—外部检验—条件性反例—修订或替代”的时间线；人工核对挑战是否针对相同版本与威胁模型；固定后续观察期并保留删失。
how.en: Timelines of proposal, outside test, conditional counter-example, revision or replacement; check by hand whether a challenge targets the same version and threat model; fixed follow-up windows with censoring.

alt.zh: 预印本与审稿时间可能使后续论文来不及看到挑战；反例可能针对不同条件；继续采用一个方法可能有合理目的。
alt.en: Preprint and review timing can hide a challenge; counter-examples may target other conditions; continued use can be reasonable.

can.zh: 可报告可追溯的修订案例，也可描述在充分时间与适用条件下的回应不足。
can.en: Traced revisions can be reported, and gaps in response under stated time and conditions.

cannot.zh: 不推断作者意图，不给团队贴标签。
cannot.en: No inference about intent, no labels on teams.

ours.zh: 第一轮由 DeepSeek 读引用句。独立智能体审计发现，20 条“反证”里只有 4 条成立，其余多是没有结果支撑的批评，或把引用方向弄反（被引论文其实是证据来源）。因此规则收严（cites-v2）：反证必须有结果支撑，被引工作必须是被挑战的一方，并新增“批评”一类。按新规则由 Claude Opus 5.5 重读全部候选，另抽 1,000 条背景引用估计漏检。下方数字来自收严后的读取，旧读取列在换口径里。是否同条件、后续是否回应，仍需逐案核对时间线。
ours.en: DeepSeek read the citing sentences first. An independent agent audit found only 4 of 20 'counter-evidence' labels held; most were critiques without results or reversed roles (the cited paper was the source of the evidence). The rules were tightened (cites-v2): counter-evidence needs results, the cited work must be the one challenged, and critique is its own intent. Claude Opus 5.5 re-read every candidate under these rules, plus 1,000 background citations to estimate misses. The numbers below come from the stricter reading; the old one is listed under other definitions. Same conditions and later responses still need case timelines.

next.zh: 引用意图全量后生成候选清单，进入审计。
next.en: Candidate list once intents are in, then audit.

q.zh: 研究主题更新与验证方式更新是否同步？
q.en: Do evaluation methods update along with research topics?

need.zh: 在同一方向、同一时期的同一批论文上联合：方向、时间、基准使用、模型角色、主张层次与测量层次。不能把全领域的增长与另一批论文的评测问题拼成结论。
need.en: Join on the same papers of the same directions and period: direction, time, benchmark use, model roles, claimed and measured layers. Field-wide growth and evaluation issues of other papers cannot be stitched into one result.

joint.zh: 未开始：等 F21 的主张层次和实验方案卡全量结果。
joint.en: Not started: waits for F21's claimed layer and the full protocol run.

q.zh: 研究之间有没有联系、结果能不能比较、验证依据是否来自足够不同的来源？
q.en: Are studies linked, can results be compared, and do checks come from different enough sources?

need.zh: 先识别共同资源，再检验实验协议，最后检查评判与模型依赖。共同基准可能同时提高可比性并增加共同依赖，两者并不矛盾。
need.en: First find shared resources, then test protocols, then judge and model dependence. A shared benchmark can raise comparability and dependence at once; these do not conflict.

outcomes.zh: 共同资源正在形成可累积的评测规范
outcomes.en: Shared resources are forming a cumulative norm

outcomes.zh: 共享增加但核心配置差异仍大
outcomes.en: More sharing, core set-ups still differ

outcomes.zh: 共同名称尚未充分转化为可比较结果
outcomes.en: Shared names have not yet become comparable results

outcomes.zh: 共享与可比性均增加，但依赖集中
outcomes.en: Sharing and comparability up, dependence concentrated

outcomes.zh: 标准化有进展，替代与独立验证值得进一步检查
outcomes.en: Standardisation progresses; alternatives and independent checks deserve a look

outcomes.zh: 资源分散且协议可映射
多样化也可能通过明确映射支持比较
outcomes.en: Diversity can support comparison through explicit mappings

joint.zh: 进行中：F15 已出；F16 等实验方案卡全量结果。
joint.en: In progress: F15 is in; F16 waits for the full protocol run.

q.zh: 围绕同一个成果，引用、采用、独立采用和跨方向迁移是什么关系？
q.en: For the same work, how do citation, adoption, independent adoption and movement across directions relate?

need.zh: 选统一的资源集合，以首次公开时间为起点，比较同年龄窗口的采用与引用；高引用低采用、低引用高采用和其他情况都抽案例，检查类别差异与漏检。
need.en: Take one set of resources from first release, compare adoption and citation at equal age; draw cases from every quadrant and check category differences and missed detections.

joint.zh: 进行中：F17、F18 象限已出；引用语境与 F23 等引用意图全量结果。
joint.en: In progress: F17 and the F18 quadrants are in; contexts and F23 wait for the citation intents.

q.zh: 开放问题与外部反例出现后，研究如何回应，主张是否修订？
q.en: After open problems and outside counter-evidence, how does research respond, and are claims revised?

need.zh: 每个案例保留原始主张、适用条件、挑战设置、后续回应和公开日期；挑战是否成立、是否针对同一条件由人工判断。没有引用某篇论文，不足以判断作者没有回应它。
need.en: Each case keeps the original claim, its conditions, the challenge, the later response and dates; whether a challenge holds and matches the conditions is judged by people. Not citing a paper does not show it went unanswered.

joint.zh: 未开始：等引用意图全量结果与人工审计。
joint.en: Not started: waits for citation intents and the human audit.

standards.zh: 比例旁同时给出分子、分母、单位、时间窗和缺失。论文、实验、论文对、资源、机构和“方向 × 季度”是不同单位。未结束的半年不与完整半年直接比较；等待时间要包含尚未发生事件的对象（删失）。
standards.en: Every share comes with numerator, denominator, unit, window and missing. Papers, experiments, pairs, resources, institutions and direction-quarters are different units. Incomplete half-years are not compared with complete ones; waiting times include objects still waiting (censoring).

standards.zh: 论文对共享论文、方向季度重复观察同一方向、多个实验可能来自同一团队，不能都当独立样本。行列独立基线只描述偏离独立分布，不定义应有研究量；家族重合要与流行度条件下的基线比较。
standards.en: Pairs share papers, direction-quarters repeat directions and experiments may share teams; they are not independent samples. Independence baselines only show departures, not how much research there should be; family overlap is compared with a popularity-conditioned baseline.

standards.zh: 抽取准确性与语料范围
两个自动标注器之间的一致率不等于人工准确率；关键关系要有独立人工审计，精度与漏检分开评价。全文缺失、旧论文覆盖不足与分类变化都可能制造趋势。
standards.en: Agreement between two automatic labellers is not human accuracy; key relations need an independent human audit, with precision and recall assessed separately. Missing full texts, thin early coverage and changing labels can all create trends.

standards.zh: 保留所有候选、已试口径、失败的分析和版本变化；事后选择的阈值不能称为预注册。没有差异、趋势消失、预测增益很弱的结果同样保留。
standards.en: Keep all candidates, definitions tried, failed analyses and version changes; thresholds picked afterwards are not pre-registered. No difference, vanishing trends and weak predictive gains are kept too.

corrections.en: Reaching five works is when a direction began

corrections.zh: 阈值起点是操作定义，须改变阈值检验

corrections.en: Noted on F1; threshold sensitivity to run

corrections.en: A shared benchmark means comparable experiments

corrections.zh: 共享名称与协议一致分开验证
corrections.en: Shared names and same protocols are checked separately

corrections.zh: 网页卡片已改为“在多大程度上共享基准”；可比性见 F16
corrections.en: Web card renamed to 'how much defences share benchmarks'; comparability is F16

corrections.zh: 排名重合低代表产出与供给无关
corrections.en: Low top-set overlap means output and supply are unrelated

corrections.zh: 相关性与头部重合测量不同现象
corrections.en: Correlation and top-set overlap measure different things

corrections.zh: 网页卡片改称“资源供给”，F3 卡片写明两者正相关
corrections.en: Web card now says 'resource supply'; F3 states they correlate positively

corrections.zh: 提交少等于代码无用或被遗弃
corrections.en: Few commits means useless or abandoned code

corrections.zh: 控制年龄与软件成熟度，实际采用另测
corrections.en: Control age and maturity; measure adoption separately

corrections.zh: 网页卡片拆成关注度、维护、许可证三项
corrections.en: Web card split into attention, upkeep and licence

corrections.zh: 家族重合代表自己给自己评分并有偏差
corrections.en: Family overlap means self-grading with bias

corrections.zh: 先核实真实评判边，再检验影响
corrections.en: Verify real judging edges first, then test effects

corrections.zh: 网页卡片改为“家族有多大重合”；第一层加条件基线
corrections.en: Web card renamed to 'how much they overlap by family'; level 1 has a conditional baseline

corrections.zh: 62 次事件代表 62 个独立方向
corrections.en: 62 events are 62 distinct directions

corrections.zh: “方向 × 季度”与首次进入分别统计
corrections.en: Direction-quarters and first entries counted separately

corrections.zh: 网页卡片写明计数单位；去重版本待补
corrections.en: Web card states the unit; deduplicated version to add

corrections.zh: 时间外提升与总体基础率可以直接混算
corrections.en: Out-of-time lift converts with the overall base rate

corrections.zh: 按各自测试窗口的分母与基础率报告
corrections.en: Report each test window's base and rate

corrections.zh: F12 卡片注明
corrections.en: Noted on F12

corrections.zh: 独立性期望代表应有研究量
corrections.en: The independence expectation is how much research there should be

corrections.zh: 先确定真实具有相关组件的适用系统
corrections.en: First fix systems that really have the components

corrections.zh: 网页卡片改为“当前独立性基线的期望”
corrections.en: Web card now says 'independence baseline'

corrections.zh: 出现任何新模型代表被测目标较新
corrections.en: Any new model named means the tested target is new

corrections.zh: 按角色及精确版本计算
corrections.en: Compute by role and exact version

corrections.zh: 网页卡片改为“点名的最新模型”，按角色分析待补
corrections.en: Web card now says 'newest model named'; by-role analysis to add

corrections.zh: 摘要 5.2% 与全文 10.5% 构成自适应检验比例的上下界
corrections.en: 5.2% (abstracts) and 10.5% (full texts) bound the adaptive-testing share

corrections.zh: 两者分母和识别标准不同，不能形成区间
corrections.en: Different bases and criteria; no interval

corrections.zh: 网页卡片已改写；统一样本的直接读取进行中
corrections.en: Web card rewritten; direct reading on one sample in progress

corrections.zh: 未报告或使用代理指标代表方法无效
corrections.en: Not reported or proxy metrics mean the method fails

corrections.zh: 区分报告完整性与实际效果
corrections.en: Separate completeness of reporting from effects

corrections.zh: F19、F21 只回答报告与测量层次，不回答效果
corrections.en: F19 and F21 answer reporting and layers, not effects

verify.en: Are the data and relations right

verify.zh: 独立人工标注、原文核验、重算与敏感性分析
verify.en: Independent human labels, source checks, recomputation and sensitivity

verify.zh: 不以专家印象确认每一条关系
verify.en: Expert impressions do not confirm relations

verify.zh: 模式如何解释、是否重要
verify.en: What a pattern means and whether it matters

verify.zh: 带证据的发现卡与专家评议
赞同比例不是因果或事实证明
平台是否帮助研究工作
真实任务与对照条件下的阅读测试
好用评分不代替分析结论的验证
verify.en: Usability ratings do not validate results

limit.zh: 引用期望未控制年龄与学科差异
limit.en: Citation expectations not adjusted for age or discipline

limit.zh: 论文数量变化不代表现实攻击频率；份额下降不等于研究减少
limit.en: Paper counts are not attack frequency; a falling share is not less work

reason.zh: 说明研究重心正移向工具、执行与工作流，是后续“验证是否跟上”这条问题链的起点
reason.en: Shows attention moving to tools, execution and workflows; the start of the 'do tests keep up' chain

limit.zh: 分类结构，用作其他发现的分层条件
limit.en: A classification, used to stratify other findings

limit.zh: 论文数量变化不直接代表现实攻击频率
limit.en: Paper counts are not attack frequency

limit.zh: 这是研究关注的分布，不代表攻防能力或风险缺口
limit.en: Research attention, not attack or defence capability or a risk gap

limit.zh: 两项比例口径不同，不构成区间；实际开展检验的比例待统一样本与人工核验
limit.en: Two shares on different bases are not bounds; the actual share awaits one sample and human checks

reason.zh: 直接关系到防御结论有多可信；同时是一个需要改正旧说法的例子
reason.en: Bears directly on how far defence results can be trusted, and corrects an earlier claim

limit.zh: 环境类型不是质量等级
limit.en: Environment type is not a quality ranking

limit.zh: 点名至少两次即计入，不区分角色
limit.en: Counted when named twice, roles not separated

limit.zh: 点名的最新模型不等于被测模型；部分日期为 OpenRouter 上架月份
limit.en: The newest model named is not the tested model; some dates are OpenRouter listing months

limit.zh: 同一论文内的共现，不是核实过的评判关系，也不证明偏差
limit.en: Co-occurrence in a paper, not a verified judging relation, and not evidence of bias

limit.zh: 比值低不等于没有代码
limit.en: A low ratio is not no code

limit.zh: 更新少可能是代码已成熟；星数不等于使用
limit.en: Few updates can mean finished code; stars are not use

limit.zh: 是否由少数热门基准主导仍需检查
limit.en: Whether a few popular benchmarks dominate is still to check

reason.zh: 把引用关系与共同实验资源连起来，是平台独有的视角
reason.en: Joins citations with shared experimental resources, a view only the platform has

limit.zh: 未记录到采用不等于没有价值，可能是年龄、适用范围或漏检
limit.en: No recorded use is not no value; age, scope or missed detections may explain it

reason.zh: 从“基准有多少”推进到“基准有没有被别人用、被谁用”
reason.en: Moves from how many benchmarks to whether, and by whom, they are used

limit.zh: 引用次数不能直接认定方法依赖
limit.en: Citation counts are not methodological dependence

limit.zh: 比例下降不等于合作数量减少
limit.en: A falling share is not fewer joint works

limit.zh: 未控制年龄与主题，不等同国家科研质量
limit.en: Not adjusted for age or topic; not national research quality

limit.zh: 早期文献覆盖有限，不能确立开创权
limit.en: Early coverage is partial; does not establish who founded a direction

limit.zh: 引用量不能推断是否读过文献
limit.en: Citation counts do not show what authors read

limit.zh: 按“研究线 × 季度”计，同一研究线可能多次计入
limit.en: Counted as line-quarters; one line can count more than once

limit.zh: 独立性基线不是研究应有数量
limit.en: The independence baseline is not how much research there should be

limit.zh: 头部按“占一半工作的最大研究线”定义，阈值会影响结果
limit.en: The head is the largest lines holding half the works; the threshold matters

limit.zh: 一年前固定的头部与事后重新定义的头部要分开
limit.en: A head fixed a year ago and one redefined afterwards are different

limit.zh: 份额下降不等于绝对研究量下降
limit.en: A falling share is not less work

limit.zh: 术语传播不等于方法迁移；新术语观察期更短
limit.en: Terms spreading is not methods moving; newer terms have shorter windows

limit.zh: 事后挑出的成功案例不能证明事前可预测
limit.en: Risers picked afterwards do not show they were predictable

limit.zh: “达到 N 篇”是操作定义，不是方向的真实起点
limit.en: Reaching N works is an operational start, not the origin

limit.zh: “达到 N 篇”是操作定义，不是方向的真实起点
limit.en: Reaching N works is an operational start, not the origin

limit.zh: 供给只看可识别的基准，不涵盖方法贡献；两项指标正相关
limit.en: Supply covers identifiable benchmarks only; the two measures correlate positively

limit.zh: 只计有基准采用记录的防御；共用名称不等于可以直接比较
limit.en: Only defences with recorded benchmark use; a shared name is not direct comparability

reason.zh: 不同防御的结果能否积累，取决于它们能否比较；这里先给出共享程度，可比性由 F16 检验
reason.en: Whether defence results accumulate depends on comparability; this gives sharing, F16 tests comparability

limit.zh: 关联按引用与语义相似；未观测到回应不等于无人研究或没有解决
limit.en: Related by citation and similarity; no response seen is not unstudied or unsolved

reason.zh: 把研究版图与知识更新连起来，形成有证据的研究议程
reason.en: Links the landscape to how knowledge updates, toward an evidence-based agenda

limit.zh: 尚未被采用的基准需要按删失处理
limit.en: Benchmarks not yet used need censoring

limit.zh: 回顾性差异，不是预测
limit.en: A retrospective difference, not a prediction

limit.zh: 1.18 倍来自一次时间切分
limit.en: The ×1.18 comes from a single time split

limit.zh: 各家族的分母是各自的论文集合，角色可重叠
limit.en: Each family's base is its own papers; roles overlap

name.en: Where research is, and the move to execution

资源是否被外部团队采用
name.en: Are resources taken up by outside teams

name.zh: 开放问题与新证据如何得到回应
name.en: How open problems and new evidence are answered

exploring.zh: 关键定义、抽取、分析或解释仍在推进；不写成最终结论
exploring.en: Definitions, extraction, analysis or interpretation still under way; not a final result

preliminary.zh: 已有可定位的结果，但人工审计或稳健性检查未完成

revised.en: Scope changed, evidence insufficient or merged elsewhere; old version and reason kept
